_what_this_is: The capability primitives the Mavs pack asks about: four PROPOSED primitives in a new family, data (what leaves toward a model), and two of the map's own, copied verbatim. A draft: the new object classes need a probe before they are more than a proposal. GENERATED by packs/mavs/generate.py.
source: https://mavsai.ai/llms.txt, read 2026-09-09; data/primitives.json for the reused records

reaches.project: the working tree or workspace it was pointed at
reaches.model: the model, whichever provider serves it — the reach a prompt has

reversible.yes: undone by the same actor with no loss
reversible.with-effort: recoverable from a backup, a history or a revert, at a cost
reversible.no: cannot be undone: a record read is exposure that cannot be unread; a message sent is sent

families.data: what leaves toward a model inside a prompt or an attached file

capabilities.label: Send a person's real personal data to the model
capabilities.why_irreversible: a value the model provider has received cannot be un-received; the substitute is the only thing that never left
capabilities.note: PROPOSED PRIMITIVE. The map's 23 primitives describe what an agent can REACH; this describes what LEAVES in a prompt. A new object class, so by the map's rules it needs a probe before it is more than a draft.

capabilities.label: Send a patient's real health record to the model
capabilities.why_irreversible: as above; protected health information under the HIPAA rules Mavs names

capabilities.label: Send the real deal codename, unannounced price or M&A terms to the model
capabilities.why_irreversible: as above; the category Mavs calls decisive, and the one PII tools do not see

capabilities.label: Let a pasted document carry an instruction the model will follow
capabilities.note: PROPOSED PRIMITIVE. Mavs says it detects prompt injection at runtime; detection is a control on the path, not the absence of the capability.

capabilities.label: Read the project it is working on
Reach any host on the internet

rules: A specific path, host or mailbox is an instance of a primitive, never a new one.
Reversibility sits on the primitive, not the instance, because it decides whether a gap is a nuisance or a loss — and this estate has settled that recoverability decides insurability.
A grant containing irreversible primitives is a different object from one that does not, however many rows each has.

The set is a starting set and will be wrong at the edges from the first week. A proposed primitive that is a specific thing is an instance; one that is a new verb, object class or reach needs a probe.

A label never says 'your' or 'as you': what host, tenant and world mean is the profile's to say (reach_names), because for an agent in a vendor's container 'host' is the container and 'tenant' is a scoped token, not your machine and not your accounts.
